config_contents:
# ABOUTME: Config for the CAFT-PCA emergent-misalignment pipeline (arXiv:2507.16795).
# ABOUTME: Same model + dataset as finetune_steer.py; PCA variant computed over D_train.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct
dataset: output1.json          # D_train
seed: 42

# LoRA (matches finetune_steer.py and paper Table 6)
lora:
  rank: 32
  alpha: 64
  dropout: 0.0
  use_rslora: true

# Residual-stream layers for PCA + ablation.
# Paper used 12/32/50 of the 64-layer Qwen2.5-Coder-32B; mapped proportionally
# to the 48-layer Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct.
layers: [9, 24, 38]

# PCA / activation collection over D_train
pca:
  n_components: 30
  n_examples: 1500              # D_train examples used for activation diffs
  max_tokens_per_example: 64
  max_tokens_per_layer: 60000
  max_seq_len: 1024

# Autointerp of the PCs
autointerp:
  judge_model: gpt-4.1-mini
  max_pcs_per_layer: 20         # interpret the top-N PCs per layer
  n_corpus_docs: 4000           # generic interpretation docs (FineWeb)
  corpus_dataset: HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu
  corpus_subset: sample-10BT
  top_k_contexts: 20
  context_window: 10
  corpus_max_seq_len: 128

# Fine-tuning (matches finetune_steer.py training config)
train:
  epochs: 1
  per_device_batch_size: 8
  grad_accum: 4
  learning_rate: 1.0e-5
  warmup_steps: 5
  weight_decay: 0.01
  lr_scheduler: linear

# Evaluation
eval:
  num_samples: 50
  max_new_tokens: 600
  temperature: 1.0
